title: Audit Log Query Builder + Async Export Jobs (CSV/JSON)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Replace current ad-hoc audit exporter with a robust Query Builder UI and backend async export job pipeline. Goals: flexible filter composer (time ranges, actor, resource, action, SAML session id, IP), cursor-based+page-based pagination, downloadable CSV/JSON exports via signed URLs, saved queries for auditors, and RBAC-v2 enforced scoping so non-admins only see permitted records. Also add PII redaction mode for exports and audit trail for export actions.
steps: 1) Implement backend query DSL and parameter validation. 2) Add async export job queue with S3-compatible signed URL delivery. 3) Wire frontend Query Builder UI with saved query CRUD. 4) Integrate RBAC-v2 permission checks at query and export job creation time. 5) Add telemetry and audit event for export creation/download. 6) E2E tests for pagination/cursor correctness and CSV/JSON formatting.
acceptance_criteria: - UI exposes combinable filters (actor, org, team, action, resource_type, resource_id regex, date range, SAML session). - Export creation responds quickly and returns job id; job produces signed URL when complete. - Export files produce correct CSV and JSON formats matching schema and respect PII redaction toggle. - Saved queries persist per org with name/description and owner; users may share with team. - Users without audit:list/export permission cannot create export jobs or access saved queries they don't have rights to. - All export actions generate audit events (export.created, export.completed, export.downloaded) with metadata.
decisions: - Use cursor-based pagination for UI logs listing; backend provides both cursor and page params but UI prefers cursor for performance. - Exports will be materialized by exporting batched query results into newline-delimited JSON (.ndjson) and a canonical CSV variant for downstream BI. - Signed URLs will be S3-compatible and expire after 7 days. - Exports will be stored in customer-scoped buckets for Private/Dedicated customers; hosted customers use multitenant export buckets with encryption. - PII redaction implemented as schema-level masking with configurable rules; default redaction removes email/SSN fields.
blockers: - Waiting on RBAC-v2 entitlement mapping from Access team (ENG-19840). - Need SAML context enrichment in logging pipeline (LogShip change requested; dependency ENG-19901).
